A wonderful app, but….. I love this app and have been using it for years. It helps keep me consistent in my daily devotional and is a wonderful and abundant resource at the tip of my fingers.

However, I believe You Veesion should remove the passion translation from its library. In my view, it is neither a faithful translation nor an accurate paraphrase. It contains extensive interpretive additions that could well beyond the original biblical text, and credible scholars have raised significant concerns about its methodology, accuracy, and originality. Presenting in alongside legitimate Bible translations risk confusing readers about what the biblical authors actually wrote. You Version has earned a reputation as a trusted platform for scripture. Including the passion translation undermines that trust and compromises the standards many users have come to expect.
